title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-007
doc_notes: This document is a personal statement by Captain Kenju Terauchi regarding the JAL Flight 1628 sighting, received by the FAA in 1987, and contains detailed encounter information.

encounters.summary: Captain Kenju Terauchi of JAL Flight 1628 reported an encounter with two smaller spaceships and a large mother ship over Alaska, which followed the aircraft for approximately 50 minutes.
encounters.entity_appearance: Two smaller ships with numerous exhaust pipes and a large mother ship.
encounters.entity_behavior: The ships performed high-speed maneuvers, matched the aircraft's speed and altitude, interfered with VHF communication, and disappeared when another aircraft approached.
encounters.quote: two spaceships stopped in front of our face, shooting off lights
